cohort: 50 puerperas with atonic postpartum hemorrhage who received uterine balloon tamponade (40 vaginal, 10 cesarean) and 50 puerperas with atonic postpartum hemorrhage who received traditional therapy (40 vaginal, 10 cesarean).
finding: Uterine balloon tamponade resulted in lower total blood loss, fewer instances of massive bleeding (>1500ml), and fewer hysterectomies compared to traditional therapy for atonic postpartum hemorrhage.
